developer:two-ironclads-stoke.title: Two Ironclads: Dark Embrace, Stoke & Feel No Pain
developer:two-ironclads-stoke.description: A recent discovery: on this seed, both Ironclads can transform starter cards at Morphic Grove into the same Dark Embrace and Feel No Pain.
developer:two-ironclads-stoke.instructions:
Two Ironclads, Ascension 10. Both players choose Leafy Poultice for Stoke.
The first question-mark room contains Morphic Grove. Transform starter cards for Dark Embrace and Feel No Pain.
This seed does not require a particular pickup order between the two players.
Listed for game 0.111.0 with full unlocks.
